description:
Paginated historical flow records for one non-stablecoin token between explicit start and end dates, optionally filtered by one wallet label. Use for date-range records or pagination. For a trailing-window summary of net USD flows AND wallet counts across categories, use get_smart_money_flows, which returns the categories together in one call. Not available for stablecoins. Native ETH is read as WETH; the token must exist on the requested chain.

[Access: pay 0.02 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

chain.description: Chain name or slug, e.g. ethereum or base.

date_from.description: ISO date string for the start of the window.

date_to.description: ISO date string for the end of the window.

filters.description: Optional filter object passed through to the upstream provider.

label.description: Wallet category: smart_money, exchange, whale, public_figure, or top_100_holders.

order_by.description: Optional ordering list passed through to the upstream provider.

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

name: get_token_flows
